domainDescription: A personal notes application. Users save arbitrary information as modules — a password, a renewal date, a phone number — and can list, search for, delete or undo a recent change to what they have saved.

capabilities.title: Remember this
capabilities.description: Save something the user wants remembered — extract the important information from what they said, wrote, or uploaded, and file it as a module, either new or appended onto one that already covers the same topic

body.description: what you want me to remember

examples: remember that my passport expires in June 2027
save this: the wifi password is on the router label
note that the landlord's number is 555-0142
take a note about the car insurance renewal date

capabilities.title: Modules
capabilities.description: Open the modules browser, listing everything saved so far grouped by category
examples: show my modules
open my notes
what have I saved
take me to my saved modules

capabilities.title: Search modules
capabilities.description: Find and open the module that best matches a topic — answers "what did I save about X" and doubles as "open" for a specific module by describing it
examples: what did I save about the passport renewal
find my note about the wifi password
look up what I wrote about the car insurance
search my notes for the landlord

capabilities.title: Delete module
examples: delete that module
forget the note about the old address
remove the wifi password module

capabilities.title: Undo last merge
capabilities.description: Undo the most recent merge into a module, restoring what it said before
examples: undo that merge
revert the passport module to before that
undo the last change to that note

capabilities.title: Live data and outside accounts
capabilities.description: Reading email, a calendar, the web, or any account outside this app. Checking the weather, the news, or anything that requires fetching live information from elsewhere.
examples: check my email for the confirmation
look up flight prices for me
what's the weather this weekend
capabilities.refusal: I can only work with what you've told me or given me directly — I can't reach your email, the web, or any other account.

capabilities.title: Acting in other apps
capabilities.description: Sending a message, email, or payment on the user's behalf. Booking, ordering, or making a change in another app or account. Setting a reminder, alarm, or calendar event.
examples: send this note to my sister
book that appointment for me
set a reminder for the renewal date
capabilities.refusal: I can save what you tell me, but I can't send messages, book anything, or act in another app on your behalf.
